about: Serving clients across the state of Georgia from The Law Office of Blake A. Poole, founder and criminal defense attorney Blake Poole works out of his office in Gainesville, Georgia. He offers counsel and representation in cases involving:

A zealous advocate with a vast knowledge of the law, Mr. Poole is an experienced trial attorney who goes the extra mile to fight for the rights of his clients. He is known for his professionalism, and he makes himself available to answer every question or doubt his clients have at any point during the legal proceedings. Ensuring his clients are well-aware of their rights, he helps them navigate complex legal processes in a stress-free manner. He holds a “Good” rating on Avvo, along with many five-star reviews from grateful clients.

Mr. Poole served as an U.S. Army Infantryman from 2005 to 2008, after which, he graduated from the University of North Georgia with a B.A. in political science. While there, he was a member of the Pi Sigma Alpha Honor Society and the Student Veterans of America. He then decided to study law and joined the Georgia State University College of Law, where he participated in the Mock Trial team and was a member of the Urban Fellows Program. Earning his law degree in 2014, he gained the license to practice law in Georgia the same year.

Active in his local community, Mr. Poole maintains memberships with the Gainesville-Northeastern Bar Association, the Gainesville Orr Inn of Court and the Leadership Hall County Class of 2016. His pro bono activities include serving on the board of the Gainesville Jaycees and the Gateway Domestic Violence Center. Furthermore, he volunteers as a legal food frenzy organizer at the Atlanta Community Food Bank.
